Bill.BriefDescription: Improving the efficiency of the permitting process when multiple agencies are involved.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to permit timelines; and adding a new section tochapter 43.42 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.42 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature finds that there are numerous efforts ongoingto streamline and improve permitting processes. These include the workof the transportation permit efficiency and accountability committee,chapter 47.06C RCW, and the efforts of the office of regulatoryassistance to develop an integrated permit system, chapter 245, Laws of2003. While these efforts are ongoing and likely to yield proceduralimprovements in permit processing by 2006, there is an immediate needto coordinate permitting timelines for large, multiagency permitstreamlining efforts. (2) With the agreement of all involved agencies and the permitapplicant, state permitting agencies may make a determination of thetimelines that will be used by each participating permit agency to makepermit decisions, including the time periods required to determine ifthe permit applications are complete, to review the application or p. 1 SB 6265applications, and to process the component permits. The time periodsmay not be less than those otherwise required for each individualpermit, but may extend and coordinate those time periods. The goal ofthe concurrent timeline is to achieve the maximum efficiencies possiblethrough concurrent studies, consolidated applications, permit review,hearings, and comment periods. A timeline established under thissubsection, with the assent of each permitting agency, must commit eachpermitting agency to act on each component permit within these timeperiods.
